verdict.rationale: Snyk provides a dedicated MCP server (Snyk Studio) documented and hands-on verified via JSON-RPC handshake, plus hooks-based agentic security to scan AI-generated code at inception, CLI slash-commands (/snyk-fix, /snyk-batch-fix) inside coding assistants, and a Remediation Agent that scans/fixes within the agent workflow. This directly matches wiring the scanner into a coding agent for pre-landing checks. Missing for 10: independent third-party validation of end-to-end AI-agent workflow beyond Snyk's own docs/probe, and scans do require authentication (snyk-probe-5) rather than being fully frictionless.
